messages.subject: Five question survey, please participate
parts:
Hi,
we need your help planning the next steps for RHadoop and we hope a survey will be a useful way to achieve that. It  is only five questions and they allow free text answers if you are, like me, annoyed at check lists that always miss the important points. The five questions are about use cases, data, algorithms, problems and desired features all as related to RHadoop. Please take a little time to complete the survey and forward the link to other RHadoop users. Thanks

Antonio

PS: if you missed the link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheet/viewform?formkey=dFlDVEs4STF0NXZON2xEbDVMc2doUVE6MQ
